scenario.name: r-cd-token-bracket-delegate
scenario.description: Terminal [[CONTINUE_DELEGATE:...]] path from an isolated raw-final-text child; joins a runner-owned attempt to exactly one origin task, one token-scheduled delegate, completion, return, and Tempo topology.
scenario.registryNotes: Issue #426 runnable repair: runner owns the attempt/nonce before launch; scenario requires a disposable raw-final-text origin and exactly one nonce-bound origin/delegate task identity through a settle window.

seatClassExpectation.reason: Bracket scanner fires only on scanned-final-text. Seats that route final-text through message(send) body kill the scanner (bracketIdx=-1). ronan-dgx IS a message-body seat in its default Discord delivery — expected HONEST-LIMIT unless raw-final-text mode is forced (no message-tool call that turn). See TOOLS.md bracket-position-sensitive notes.

review.notes: Bracket/token path. On message-body-delivery seats (ronan-dgx default), expected outcome is HONEST-LIMIT-candidate (scanner killed). PASS-candidate only on raw-final-text seats. candidateSha and seat resolved from env at runtime.

liveRunSafety.notes: PASS requires a runner-owned attempt, disposable raw-final-text origin, exactly one origin task and one token-scheduled delegate task through a settle window, exact completion/return binding, and public Tempo topology. Message-body/unknown surfaces are HONEST-LIMIT; interruption is structured PARTIAL and never auto-retried.
